councilcraft.emi.info.exposure.photograp: Printed in a Lightroom from a developed film roll and Paper, not in a crafting grid. A black-and-white print uses 1 Black Dye; a color print uses 1 each of Cyan, Magenta, Yellow and Black Dye. Copies of a photograph or a signed album are made in a Printer, not in a crafting grid: a black-and-white copy uses Black Dye fluid, a color copy uses Process Ink, mixed in a Create Mixer from 250 mB Black Dye fluid plus 1 each of Cyan, Magenta and Yellow Dye (makes 250 mB).
councilcraft.emi.info.exposure.lightroom: Prints photographs: put in a developed film roll, Paper and printing dyes (Cyan, Magenta, Yellow, Black), pick a frame and press Print. Needs light level 13 or brighter just above it.
councilcraft.emi.info.exposure.film: After taking photos, develop the roll in a crafting grid: black-and-white film with a Water Bottle, color film with an Awkward, a Thick and a Mundane Potion. Then print it in a Lightroom.
